notes.title: Reach higher with the static crane!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Constructors![/b][/h1]

It's time for another [b]update[/b] on [b]Heavy Duty Costruction[/b].
This time instead of driving left and right, [b]we will go up[/b].

[h3]We present to you the [b]static crane[/b]![/h3]

This machine will help you with [b]bigger constructions[/b] requiring [b]reaching higher[/b] than the mobile crane allows you to and [b]lifting even heavier objects[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43404090/05dda01819abd8baa665ddd38c5b5899f354cc37.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43404090/09d7bc901d5f078bc1cc4a7b2647d00a38cbf0dc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43404090/9d3e47afee22cdbc0bcde3a4c005c26314824107.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43404090/1b4febbc40e6592559580dfe08be4693ecf637d4.png[/img]

[h3][b]What do you think? Let us know[/b] in the “discuss” section.[/h3]

And if you have any [b]questions[/b] or simply want to [b]stay up to date[/b] - [b]join our Discord[/b] and become a part of [b]Madnetic Games Community[/b] family

[url=https://discord.gg/5NB6wKjQBx][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40090453/bd6668c45a94a501fab5b0f3b15cdb066b1598f8.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: This crane will lift your spirits!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Constructors![/b][/h1]

[h3]Thursday became our [b]unofficial Progress Sharing Day[/b] - so we’re back to present to you [b]another vehicle.[/b][/h3]

With the [b]excavator[/b] and the [b]dump truck[/b] you can already dig and load different materials to move them from one place to another. But [b]working on a construction site requires heavy lifting as well.[/b]

[h2][b]This brand new mobile crane will come in handy![/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43404090/1bc0fa51f37479fd4859d775e875815c42cbb86c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43404090/ce1004b94797c50c9953409f95caee49dff2e819.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43404090/358d8e2eb5e0418dbb3620508a12dd34b5377e4c.png[/img]

[h2][b]What do you think?[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Let us know[/b] in the “discuss” section below![/h3]

And if you have any [b]questions[/b] or simply want to [b]stay up to date[/b] - [b]join our Discord[/b] and become a part of [b]Madnetic Games Community[/b] family

[url=https://discord.gg/5NB6wKjQBx][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40090453/bd6668c45a94a501fab5b0f3b15cdb066b1598f8.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Heavy Duty Construction takeover
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hi Constructors![/b][/h1]

[h3][b]Madnetic Games Team[/b] here![/h3]

We wanted to officially announce that
[h2][b]Madnetic Games[/b] takes over [b]Heavy Duty Construction[/b][/h2]

It’s [b]exciting[/b] for us to take this [b]project under our wing![/b] To mark this [b]new chapter[/b] we decided to
[h3][b]change the game’s logo[/b] a bit[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43404090/8a55437e186e469f29c03c25ed699a6d51e3d77b.png[/img]

[h3]and open a [b]new channel[/b] on our [b]Discord![/b][/h3]
So if you want to [b]stay up to date[/b] make sure to [b]join us[/b] and become a part of [b]Madnetic Games Community[/b] family
